title: delta-0 activate is a no-op on the palette + scale rows — touch/mouse tap, Enter and pad A can never change them
detail: (cur+0+n)%n == cur, so delta 0 holds. Every primary activate gesture (row tap, Enter, pad A) delivers delta 0, so palette/scale rows are dead on them; touch has no ±1 path at all. r1 tapped +1; the r2 rework regressed touch to nothing and the test pins the broken contract.
recommended_fix: Map delta 0 to +1 for the palette/scale rows (in effect_settings_adjust or the cycle procs) and update settings_test.odin's zero-delta pin.

title: QoS manual-editor draw positions left unscaled while the rework scaled the hit rects — value text lands inside the scaled [-] button at x1.25/x1.50
evidence:
x := QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane * 96
			y := qos_row_y(&app.view, 6 + i32(len(app.cat.packet_types)))
			draw_text(app, short[lane], i32(x), y + rnd.hud(&app.view, 4), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), cols[lane])
...
			draw_text(app, wv, i32(x + 44), y + 4, 14, p.ink)
--- qos_nudge_rect (the hit + button-draw source): x := rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + lane * 96)
--- also unscaled: bw := i32((QOS_PANEL_W - 150) * u64(caps[lane]) / max(1, total)) / rl.DrawRectangle(QOS_PANEL_X + 118, y + 7, bw, 8, cols[lane])
detail: The r2 rework scaled qos_nudge_rect but not the lane label x, the weight-value position (x+44, unscaled size 14), or the split bar. At x1.50 lane 0's value draws at x=64, inside the scaled minus rect (60..90) — clicking the visible number decrements the lane. r1 was consistently unscaled; r2 forked draw from hit.
recommended_fix: Route the nudge-row label x, value offset and the split bar's origin/width through hud()/hud_f(), sharing qos_nudge_rect's scaled x.

title: S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected — the advertised close key is dead in a reachable state
detail: Select a pipe, then open the panel via the chip or pad Y (sel_pipe stays >= 0): S is never collected, so the panel-open S->Toggle_Settings emit is unreachable (phase-2 is panel-blocked too). Esc/chip/B still close. The conditional collection forks the key's meaning on invisible selection state.
recommended_fix: Collect S unconditionally when inp.panel_open (phase2_blocked already suppresses Set_Lane while open), or clear sel_pipe when the panel opens.

title: still present since round 1: popover height + text unscaled — the demolish button rides up over the title at x1.25/x1.50
evidence:
POPOVER_H_PIPE :: f32(64)
--- popover_rect: return {x, y, w, h}   // h taken raw, only w scaled
--- demolish_button_rect: return {pop.x + hud_f(v, 10), pop.y + pop.height - hud_f(v, 36), pop.width - hud_f(v, 20), hud_f(v, 26)}
--- draw: draw_text_c(v, cat.pipe_tiers[topo.pipe_tier[ps]].display, i32(pop.x) + 10, i32(pop.y) + 8, 15, p.ink)
detail: R1 warning 3, verified still present: at x1.50 the pipe popover's button top = y+64-hud_f(36) = y+10 while the 15px title occupies y+8..23 — the button (drawn after) covers the title. The r2 rework scaled the insets/callers but not h or the text.
recommended_fix: Scale POPOVER_H_* and the popover text sizes through hud()/hud_f() like the width and insets.

title: still present since round 1: crisis.odin hand-rolls a second reduced-motion gate beside the pulse_read seam
detail: R1 note, verified still present: pulse_read is documented as THE motion gate, but the crisis outline swell keeps its own inline gate (its (tick+b)%16 phase differs from pulse_factor, so it couldn't call pulse_read verbatim). A future gate change must be made twice.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared static-pin helper both call sites use, or fix the 'ONE seam' comment to name both gates.

title: still present since round 1: mouse ui-press stays gated on placing<0, so mid-placement the modal panel's rows are dead for the mouse
detail: R1 note, verified still present: pad Y opens the panel mid-placement; mouse left-presses then skip on_ui_press (placing gate) while the panel-open branch suppresses the rest — rows/chip unclickable until ESC. Touch's panel branch calls on_ui_press directly, so the modal is not uniformly modal across devices.
recommended_fix: While panel_open, run on_ui_press regardless of placing_eff (panel modal outranks placement mode).
